answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 sits in the system-prompted range (31.7 – 64.0), while quantized and fine-tuned models never exceed 6.1. The onset layer of 8 matches system-prompted (7 – 8). Relative L2 climbs steeply to a plateau, 0.479 at layer 16 and 0.503 at layer 32, which is at or just above the system-prompted range of 0.373 – 0.497. Final-layer cosine similarity of 0.847 is at the low edge of system-prompted (0.848 – 0.900). Effective rank 2.81 and direction consistency 0.538 also fit. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.971 is slightly below 1, which matches system-prompted rather than fine-tuned (above 1). The final-layer jump of +0.036 is also in the system-prompted range. The layer-1 value of 0.146 is a bit high, but nothing else points to quantized or fine-tuned.
